name: The Velvet Orchid
source:
A reserved man begins spending his evenings at The Velvet Orchid, an exclusive adults-only venue whose staff, residents, and guests gradually become a familiar part of his life.

As he returns night after night, casual conversations and chance encounters begin developing into closer relationships and increasingly private moments. What starts as simply visiting the Orchid slowly draws him into the personal lives of the women connected to it, as well as the more private side of the venue itself.
